heading: October 22 · Komodo Island Boat Trip
activities: 6:30 AM · Buffet breakfast ready at the restaurant near the pool.
7:30 AM · Meet in the Sudamala Resort hotel lobby and depart for the harbor.
Boat trip: Komodo Island, Pink Beach, Taka Makassar, Manta Point, and offshore island snorkeling.
Around 4:30 PM · Expected return to the hotel.
Provided on the boat: towels, water, fruit, snacks (chips), and soft drinks.
bring: Comfortable footwear for the walk or sandals.
Cash for extra drinks, souvenirs, and snacks.
changes: Komodo boat lunch is a boxed meal; select one in Panji's WhatsApp poll: fried rice with chicken and egg; fried noodles with chicken and egg; or grilled chicken breast with potatoes and sautéed vegetables.
Sudamala Resort facilities, Wi-Fi, and house rules remain available in the app's Guide section.
